lines.2: All four of us childhood friends went to the same middle school.
lines.3: But Subaru was the only one in my class.
lines.4: Konoe was in the same class too.
lines.5: Serious and strong-willed about justice even then, Konoe sometimes rubbed the class the wrong way.
lines.6: Everyone was at the age where they wanted to fool around, and she was simply too serious.
lines.7: She was like a nagging class representative.
lines.9: But Konoe never cared. Every day, she kept right on dispensing justice.
lines.10: 「Date! Get to school from first period like you are supposed to. Breaking the rules really gets on my nerves! And if you keep this up, you will fall behind in class too.」
lines.11: Few people outside our circle could speak to Subaru that bluntly.
lines.12: Subaru would just brush her off with a yeah-yeah and never actually fight with her.
lines.14: 「She is not picking a fight. She is warning me for my own sake too, and I kind of like that.」
lines.15: Maybe Subaru had a thing for being scolded.
lines.16: Konoe was nagging, sure, but she was serious and polite. Even if some people found her annoying, she had proper friends too.
lines.17: So there was never really a problem.
lines.18: As for me, I was more fired up about fighting kids from neighboring schools than studying.
lines.19: I was not exactly a delinquent. More like a problem child.
lines.20: Since I did not play sports, that was where I burned off all my excess energy.
lines.21: One day, my parents were shocked to learn my grades were falling and tried to send me to cram school.
lines.22: I honestly did not care, but the classes had a good reputation, so I agreed to try it for a month. If I liked it, I could keep going.
lines.23: It was genuinely interesting, but I still did not care much about studying, so I figured it would not last.
lines.24: I was mostly doing it out of obligation to my parents.
lines.25: On the way home from cram school.
lines.27: Konoe was sitting on a bench in front of the station in her school uniform.
lines.28: She looked strangely out of place in the darkness of the night.
lines.31: Seeing someone as rule-abiding as her out in town at night felt so mismatched that it caught my attention.
lines.32: There were still a few other students in uniform around at this hour, so she probably would not get stopped by the police, but...
lines.33: I decided to talk to her.
lines.36: At the time, we were nothing more than classmates.
lines.37: She was always warning me about something, so we spoke normally enough.
lines.38: 「Heading home from cram school. Matsukasa Cram School.」
lines.42: 「You at cram school... Have you finally decided to quit acting up and return to the straight and narrow?」
lines.43: 「...I do at least have some desire not to become an idiot.」
lines.44: 「Hmm. I hope this gets you to put some of that energy into studying.」
lines.47: 「I am. I am just staying here a little longer.」
lines.50: 「Do not be late for school like the day before yesterday. Bye.」
lines.51: Even now she had to lecture me.
lines.53: Konoe was sitting on the same bench again.
lines.54: 「You are always here after cram school.」
lines.55: 「You are eating on the street, Tsushima.」
lines.56: Konoe glared at the croquette bun I was happily eating.
lines.57: 「It is not like I am on my way home from school. Who cares?」
lines.58: 「You should eat a proper meal at home. That is just common sense.」
lines.59: 「Sure, but both my parents are away on business.」
lines.60: 「So I end up eating stuff like this a lot.」
lines.62: 「Sometimes Subaru cooks for me. He is amazing. He keeps getting better and better at it.」
lines.66: 「Anyway, what exactly are you doing here?」
lines.69: Konoe tipped back her thermos and drained what was left inside.
lines.70: 「...Twenty minutes. All right, time to go.」
lines.72: 「Right. A middle-schooler should not hang around a place like this forever.」
lines.73: 「So I stay here for twenty minutes.」
lines.75: 「Do not be late for school tomorrow either.」
lines.77: 「People who throw everyone out of step get on my nerves. I cannot help it. That is just how I am.」
lines.80: Straight-laced Konoe spent exactly twenty minutes here after cram school.
lines.81: Something about it was mysterious enough to stir my curiosity.
lines.82: Maybe it was because I happened to be into mystery stories at the time.
lines.84: For some reason, she got angry. Why?
